We chose Stripe partly because it gives us access to Privy, a Stripe company, for embedded non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Privy lets us provide wallets directly inside HEVN while users retain ultimate control of their assets and private keys. Its secure-enclave architecture and programmable authorization controls give us the security and flexibility required for business payments without forcing customers to manage seed phrases or separate wallet applications. This allowed us to deliver a reliable cryptocurrency experience without building sensitive wallet infrastructure from scratch.

We chose Y Combinator because we wanted more than capital or generic startup mentorship. YC combines direct founder feedback, a high-pressure operating cadence, and a network of founders, fintech operators, investors, and partners who understand how difficult it is to build a global financial product. For HEVN, credibility and access matter: we work with sponsor banks, regulated payment partners, and companies moving material amounts across borders. YC helps us build those relationships while pushing us to stay focused on customers, launch quickly, charge early, and measure progress through real usage and revenue.

HEVN gives eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD accounts through U.S. sponsor banks.
